fields.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Smolder''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|''Dragon Practice''|buzzword3}} each time he hits an enemy champion with an {{tip|ability}}, or whenever ''{{ai|Super Scorcher Breath|Smolder}}'' kills a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}. His basic abilities deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on stacks.
* ''{{ai|Q|Smolder}}'': Deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{critical damage|25 to 55|0 to 30|critScaling=true}} {{as|of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
* ''{{ai|W|Smolder}}'': Explosions deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|55% of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
* ''{{ai|E|Smolder}}'': Attacks each deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{critical damage|8 to 12.8|0 to 4.8|critScaling=true}} {{as|of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
fields.notes:
* {{ai|Super Scorcher Breath|Smolder}} grants a stack if the target dies while the initial missile is in flight.
** This happens even if the target dies to {{ais|Super Scorcher Breath 3|Smolder|Super Scorcher Breath}} burn, giving him a total of 2 stacks.
* {{ai|Achooo!|Smolder}} can only grant a stack of {{as|Dragon Practice|buzzword3}} with the first hit against each enemy champion.
* {{ai|Flap, Flap, Flap|Smolder}} can only grant one stack of {{as|Dragon Practice|buzzword3}} per cast.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
